Production game asset for the original Chinese pixel-art cooperative beat-em-up 《与名为现实的怪物战斗的人们》, matching the appealing early-2000s Little Fighter 2 style: chunky three-head-tall anime fighters, dark crisp outlines, precise pixel clusters, blue-white Chinese school tracksuit, 2D side view. Create a clean, exact FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS sprite animation atlas, precisely sixteen equal rectangular cells in a square image. Transparent background with real alpha, no colored or checkerboard backdrop, no ground shadows, no text, no numbers, no visible grid lines. ONE full-body sprite completely inside each cell, ample transparent cell margins, no touching adjacent cells, coherent proportions and equipment across all sixteen poses. Each figure faces RIGHT, left-facing variants will be mirrored by the game. Standing feet baseline at 85% of each cell height, all figures share consistent scale; lying pose naturally has lower height but same body size. The sixteen cells in row-major order MUST be: row1: idle relaxed pose A, idle breathing pose B, walk left-foot-forward, walk right-foot-forward. row2: running stride A, running stride B, punch windup with fist withdrawn, punch forward fully extended. row3: extended forward kick, defensive guard with arms raised, jumping with knees bent, jumping forward attack. row4: hit stagger leaning back, lying fallen on side across the lower part of cell, getting up on one knee, special move projecting energy forward. Only modest integrated effects in last cell, no floating extra objects in margins. These are functional sprites for real gameplay, no presentation poster, no captions, no UI. Preserve exact 4x4 count and regular cell locations. Character: Xiaoyi, teenage Chinese boy with tousled short black hair, expressive determined face, white-and-royal-blue school tracksuit, sneakers, distinctive small orange-red backpack always worn on his back. Short blue sleeves, blue trousers with white side stripes. Each pose is same recognizable hero. Final special pose: upward backpack-powered punch with small warm orange arc; maintain the same one backpack, no duplicate bags.
